standard_prerequisites.use: The pushout equivalence setup (lemma-equivalence-categories-schemes-over-pushout, same chapter, collected as S3-morph-equivalence-categories-pushout L1424) and the algebra lemma characterizing finite type/flatness/smoothness/etaleness of algebras over fibre-product rings (More on Algebra); cited inputs with the affine-localization reduction written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Restrict to affine opens of the pushout square.
Translate each geometric property into its algebra counterpart for the fibre-product ring maps.
Apply the algebra properties-over-fibre-product lemma to get the six equivalences.
Deduce the adjunction isomorphism and quasi-inverse equivalence on flat objects.

proof_roadmap.step: Affine-localize the pushout square and translate properties to rings.
Apply the algebra fibre-product lemma and conclude the equivalence on flat objects.

difficulty_reason: In the situation of the chapter's pushout equivalence lemma (a fibre square of schemes with closed immersion and the functors F and G between schemes over Y' and triples), the lemma asserts that for G(V, U', phi) the properties locally of finite type, flat, flat and locally of finite presentation, smooth and etale hold of V' -> Y' exactly when they hold of both V -> Y and U' -> X', and moreover that for W' flat over Y' the adjunction G(F(W')) -> W' is an isomorphism, so F and G restrict to mutually quasi-inverse equivalences on the flat loci. The retained proof reduces the whole bundle of assertions, by looking over affine pieces, to the corresponding algebra statement on properties of algebras over fibre products (More on Algebra), with affineness of the pushout square supplied by the setup lemma. Retained author proof at lines 4425-4430.

dedup.scope: Label single-chapter (absent from stacks-spaces-more-morphisms). This is the flatness-permanence-plus-equivalence refinement of the pushout setup lemma.

compared.difference: No public primary interval covers the statement interval (four-gate picker and precard_gate both clear).

No card claims this label, its claim_key, or the interval 4402-4430; the setup lemma is claimed by S3-morph-equivalence-categories-pushout (L1424) on the disjoint interval 4276-4293. The pool candidate lemma-scheme-over-pushout-flat-modules at 4348-4400 was excluded for author-stated omissions and is not collected.

Different propositions: the setup card proves the existence of the F/G correspondence for the pushout square; this card proves the six property comparisons and the equivalence restricted to flat objects. Both counted.
